messages:
prod-incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging maya (oncall) and tom (sre). Streaming service p99 tail > 5s for last 6m, SLO breach detected on eu-west-1. Auto-escalation to oncall. Logs attached.

maya (oncall): On it. Seeing alert too. Which routes are noisy?

leo (eng-runtime): candidate: /v1/stream/generate. p95 ~ 400ms but p99 up to 5-8s. Increased error budget burn.

yasmin (platform): We have a spike in proxy write latency to clients around the same timeframe. TCP retransmits up a bit. No infra deploys in last 30m.

maya (oncall): Any customer-visible impact? @yasmine can you check customer-facing errors and traffic?

yasmin (platform): Quick check: 3 customers reported slow SSE flushes via support ticket IDs 1432, 1433, 1438. No 5xx spikes, just long streaming stalls then resumed.

tom (sre): Repro steps from logs: clients maintain connection, but backend flush to proxy stalls for ~4-6s then catches up — chunking delays. Looks like write backpressure from client side or proxy queueing.

leo (eng-runtime): I'm pulling runtime traces. Attaching sample span output:
```
span:stream.write -> queue_wait 3.9s -> socket_write 20ms -> ack
root cause candidate: proxy buffer saturation under slow-consumer workload
```

maya (oncall): Are we seeing large batches or long prefix cache misses?

leo (eng-runtime): Batching looks normal. Prefix cache hit rate steady. This feels network/backpressure between proxy and client. But origin's send rate spikes a bit due to sudden client reconnections.

yasmin (platform): Proxy metrics: connection_count +12%, socket_write_latency p99 increased from 30ms -> 1.2s, event loop queue depth increased. No recent config changes.

prod-incident-bot: Related runbooks: streaming-slow-consumers (link) and proxy-backpressure-triage (link). Recommended mitigations: enable aggressive keepalive, reduce proxy send window, enable client drop protection.

maya (oncall): Let's try mitigations in order: 1) roll keepalive from 60s -> 15s on proxy to drop stale sockets, 2) reduce per-connection send window to force backpressure earlier, 3) enable chunk-flush workaround on runtime (force periodic NOP chunk).

tom (sre): I can apply keepalive on gateway pool A (eu-west-1) and toggle send window. Doing keepalive toggle now on pool A.

tom (sre): keepalive set to 15s on pool A. Observing ~30s for effect as idle sockets close.

leo (eng-runtime): I pushed a small runtime flag to enable periodic flush every 500ms (no-op chunk) for streaming responses. This reduces big bursts. Command used: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/flags -d '{"stream_periodic_flush_ms":500}'`

maya (oncall): Good. Tom, watch p99s.

tom (sre): After keepalive + flush flag: p99 dropped from ~5.8s to ~1.1s within 90s. No increase in 5xx. Client tickets updated: two customers report improvement. :thumbsup:

yasmin (platform): Still seeing intermittent tail spikes for long-lived connections from one IP range. Possibly a carrier/edge issue. Tracing shows higher retransmits from that subnet.

leo (eng-runtime): For safety, rolling a temporary routing policy: route traffic from that IP range to alternate proxy set with more headroom. Applying policy now (canary 10%).

maya (oncall): Agreed. Also open a support note to affected customers explaining mitigation and asking for client-side keepalive hints.

prod-incident-bot: Incident state: mitigation applied (periodic-flush + keepalive + routing). Impact reduced. Continue monitoring 30m before clear.

tom (sre): Action items captured:
- tom: finish rolling keepalive to all pools in eu-west-1 (in progress)
- leo: keep periodic-flush flag enabled, monitor memory/CPU (risk: slight CPU overhead)
- yasmin: follow up with networking / carrier team about retransmits from IP range 
- maya: customer comms and postmortem owner

maya (oncall): I'll take postmortem. Oncall handoff at 08:00UTC — I'll update new oncall with status.

leo (eng-runtime): Quick note on toggles: flush flag code snippet for rollback:
```
# rollback
curl -X POST https://ops-api/flags -d '{"stream_periodic_flush_ms":0}'
```

tom (sre): Rolling keepalive to remaining pools now. ETA 6m.

yasmin (platform): Noted customers to mention in comms: ACME.ai (ticket 1432), FriendAnalytics (1433), EduStream (1438). All report delayed chunks but resumed. No data loss.

maya (oncall): Thanks. If p99 stays <1.5s for next 30m, we'll mark mitigated and start RCA.

prod-incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation verified at 6267890090. Monitoring until 6267890360.

maya (oncall): Mitigation confirmed. Preparing initial incident note and assigning postmortem to leo + yasmin. I'll loop in support for customer updates.

leo (eng-runtime): Early hypothesis: slow-consumer amplification at proxy under bursty reconnects + client subnetwork retransmits causing socket backpressure -> runtime queuing. Long-term: consider adaptive per-conn pacing, early-drop heuristics, smarter flush policy.

yasmin (platform): Also adding telemetry: per-conn retransmit counts and client RTT histograms to the streaming dashboard.

maya (oncall): Handing off to next oncall: @jordan (oncall) — incident is mitigated, postmortem assigned, keep monitoring until end of shift.

tom (sre): Leaving notes in pager duty and runbook. Closing live triage.

maya (oncall): Thanks team. Closing thread for live mitigation. We'll open a follow-up PM thread for RCA and long-term fixes.
